noncomputable def VTask.findGreatest (P : ℕ → Prop) (hP : DecidablePred P) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  match findSome (λ i, P i ∧ i ≤ n) with
  | some (i, _) => i
  | none => 0
where
  findSome : (α × β → Prop) → Option α
  findSome p := Id.run do
    for i in [0..n] do
      if p (i, hP i) then return i
    return none
